subject.title: fix(browser): keep copilot runtime bundle in sync

question: Should this protected browser-runtime asset update be refreshed against current `main` and accepted once real after-fix generation or extension-smoke evidence is attached?
rationale: The patch is narrow and has a plausible regression guard, but the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling and the available PR text does not independently demonstrate the regenerated browser runtime working after the change.
